name: Brand mentions and conversations review
summary: Your social media manager gets a dated digest of the week's collected mentions: customer questions, other talk about the brand, competitor references, category talk and irrelevant matches, each kept apart, with the mentions that need a reply listed oldest first and an owner beside each. It posts and replies to nothing.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of marketing work: the brand conversation review it describes for social and community teams.
